reviews.text: Gina is a very knowledgeable and effective dog trainer. A few months ago, my dog was struggling with anxiety and had begun showing aggressive behavior toward other dogs and people, likely due to several moves between countries and cities over the past year. I met with Gina and explained everything, and during our first session she carefully observed my dog’s behavior and later provided a detailed report with practical recommendations. Over the next couple of months, I followed her guidance and we continued with additional sessions. My dog is now social and happy again. I truly recommend Gina.

Gina is the best! Very professional and has a wonderful way of connecting with dogs! She helped my dog ​​with separation anxiety, and she also helped me a lot by teaching me more about my dog ​​and her behavior and working on improving it.

I also worked on her nutrition, and it was truly the best thing I ever did! Today, my dog ​​is so happy, healthy, and balanced!

Thank you, Gina, for everything!

Adelaide was adopted right at the start of her adolescence, a difficult stage for dogs too! Walks were chaotic; she was constantly overexcited, had separation anxiety, etc., and I didn't know what to do anymore.
Gina taught me how to read her emotions, her communication, and her needs. And that was the key to understanding her and being able to help her understand what she was going through and offer her tools to manage all those feelings.
Today we can go for walks without worry, and she stays home alone without any problem. We understand each other as if we speak the same language, and our bond is incredible. Highly recommended! Thank you, Gina!

With Gina's help, we've been able to understand Lola and her fears about people much better. Her support has been respectful and very caring. Thanks to her, Lola is calmer and more confident, and so are we. Highly recommended!
Thank you so much!! I'm so glad to hear that the Chancla and you experience was positive! Big hug.
Thank you! I'm so glad to hear your experience was excellent! Big hug!
Gina's loving, caring and trained treatment makes her the best person and company with whom to leave our dog, a before and after of how he behaves! Thank you, grazie Gina! ✨❤️
best foquin educator in the whole foquin city
She is an excellent professional; you can tell she loves dogs and takes care of them as if they were her children.
A love for dogs and expertise. What a professional! It's wonderful to see people so dedicated to their work. Well done, Gina!
Very good and trustworthy!

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for your feedback! It's a pleasure to support families who are committed to an education based on respect and understanding of their dogs. We're still on this journey! Warmest regards.
Thank you!! I'm so glad to hear that the support has been helpful! I'm here to continue walking alongside you whenever you need me. Big hug!
Thank you so much for your feedback! I'm glad to hear you had a positive experience. Big hug!

Pretinha is a happy dog. She lives in the countryside and does what a dog should do: explore, sniff, rest, and enjoy herself. She has no behavioral problems. The sessions were more for me than for her.

I contacted Gina because I wanted to better understand her language and strengthen our bond. Gina, as an expert in canine communication, helped me see details I hadn't noticed before. It was a close, clear, and very enriching experience. Thank you for joining us!

My dog ​​Lola and I have been working with Gina through online sessions. Lola was very fearful; walks with her were a nightmare because she pulled so much and was always very excited, and I couldn't let her off the leash anywhere because she wouldn't listen and would run off. I decided to ask Gina for help, and she has helped me understand Lola's needs and emotions. In just two months, Lola is a much more confident dog; she walks calmly, can run off-leash in the mountains... in short, Gina has changed our lives. I must highlight the effectiveness of the online sessions. At first, I wasn't very convinced by this method, but I have to say that it has worked just as well, if not better, than the in-person sessions, since Gina analyzes even the smallest details through the videos I've sent her.
Thank you!! I'm so glad to hear the experience was positive. Hugs, and I'm here for anything you need!

Flor was very afraid to go outside, a result of her past traumas. With Gina's help, we've learned to understand her and support her respectfully. Now Flor is calmer and is starting to enjoy walks. We are very grateful for the process.

We are incredibly grateful for Gina's support. Bituca was in his early teens, and we needed guidance to understand how he interacted with other dogs. Gina, being a specialist with greyhounds, was able to perfectly interpret his unique way of communicating and helped us understand him better. Bituca has gained confidence and is now much more adept at interacting with other dogs, simply being himself. Thank you, Gina!

We knew nothing about natural nutrition or BARF, and honestly, the advice from Bienestar Canino opened up a whole new world for us. Since we changed Olivia's diet, everything has improved: her health, her energy, and her overall well-being.
She's more active, lighter, no longer has intolerances or gas, and she seems so much happier. She enjoys eating, and we enjoy seeing her so healthy, happy, and full of energy.
We are so grateful for everything we've learned. Thank you, Gina!

Working with Gina has been a game-changer for us. Luna, my dog, had a very high level of reactivity towards other dogs. Walks were a constant source of tension, stress, and worry. We didn't know how to help her without making things worse.

From the very first session, the approach was completely different from anything we had tried: it wasn't just about correcting her behavior, but about understanding, observing, and supporting her. We learned to read her body language, to respect her pace, and above all, to rebuild together the security she had lost.

We worked step by step on our bond, building her trust and mine. Through play, respectful exercises, and continuous support, Luna gradually overcame her fears. Today, months later, she no longer reacts to unfamiliar dogs, she knows how to manage her emotions, and she can even interact with some of them calmly and curiously.

What I value most about this process is the respectful way Gina looked at the dog: she didn't try to force anything, but rather to understand. And that made all the difference.

Thank you for helping us rediscover peace on the street and the joy of walking together.

With Flake, we had a very strong attachment issue. He couldn't be separated from me for a moment; he would get anxious if I left or if we changed anything in our routine. Thanks to the support of Gina BienStar Canino, we learned to work on his independence little by little and without rushing.

Now Flake can be calm on his own, he relaxes more, and our relationship is much more balanced. We are closer, but with more freedom for both of us. Thank you for guiding us with such empathy!

My dog ​​Saskya was very anxious when she was left alone. She barked, whined, destroyed things, couldn't rest, and I was anxious too; I was very stressed and frustrated.
Thanks to the support of Gina BienStar Canino, we worked on her safety and confidence step by step, always with respect and without forcing anything.
Today she can stay calm, sleeps better, and I feel much calmer too. We've learned to separate without fear.
A beautiful process, full of patience and love. Thank you, Gina!
